
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggrepel)

# Hide code and unnecessary messages in the final report
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

# Load cleaned data
df <- read_csv(
  "~/tracyche712/data/Processed/CLEANED_Study_area_data_2018_2025.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  filter(
    Year >= 2019,
    !is.na(China_panel_exports_MW),
    !is.na(PV_capacity_additions_MW)
  )
```

```{r calculate-changes, include=FALSE}
# Calculate changes between consecutive years (GW)
change_2024 <- df %>%
  group_by(Area, Study_scope) %>%
  arrange(Year, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    Export_Change_GW =
      (China_panel_exports_MW - lag(China_panel_exports_MW)) / 1000,
    Addition_Change_GW =
      (PV_capacity_additions_MW - lag(PV_capacity_additions_MW)) / 1000
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(Year == 2024) %>%
  mutate(
    Quadrant = case_when(
      Export_Change_GW > 0 & Addition_Change_GW > 0 ~ "Both Increased",
      Export_Change_GW < 0 & Addition_Change_GW > 0 ~ "Exports Down / Additions Up",
      Export_Change_GW < 0 & Addition_Change_GW < 0 ~ "Both Decreased",
      Export_Change_GW > 0 & Addition_Change_GW < 0 ~ "Exports Up / Additions Down",
      TRUE ~ "No Change / On Axis"
    )
  )
```


```{r quadrant-plot, fig.width=13, fig.height=10, out.width="100%"}

# Symmetric axis limits
x_lim <- max(abs(change_2024$Export_Change_GW)) * 1.25
y_lim <- max(abs(change_2024$Addition_Change_GW)) * 1.25

ggplot(change_2024, aes(
  x = Export_Change_GW,
  y = Addition_Change_GW
)) +

  # Four quadrant background colors
  annotate("rect", xmin=-x_lim, xmax=0, ymin=0, ymax=y_lim,
           fill="#EAF2FA", alpha=0.7) +
  annotate("rect", xmin=0, xmax=x_lim, ymin=0, ymax=y_lim,
           fill="#E7F5EB", alpha=0.7) +
  annotate("rect", xmin=-x_lim, xmax=0, ymin=-y_lim, ymax=0,
           fill="#F3EDF8", alpha=0.7) +
  annotate("rect", xmin=0, xmax=x_lim, ymin=-y_lim, ymax=0,
           fill="#FFF0E8", alpha=0.7) +

  # Zero reference lines
  geom_hline(yintercept=0, linetype="dashed", color="grey45") +
  geom_vline(xintercept=0, linetype="dashed", color="grey45") +

  # Quadrant labels
  annotate("text", x=-Inf, y=Inf,
           label="Exports ↓ / Additions ↑",
           hjust=-0.1, vjust=1.5, size=4, fontface="bold") +
  annotate("text", x=Inf, y=Inf,
           label="Both ↑",
           hjust=1.1, vjust=1.5, size=4, fontface="bold") +
  annotate("text", x=-Inf, y=-Inf,
           label="Both ↓",
           hjust=-0.1, vjust=-0.6, size=4, fontface="bold") +
  annotate("text", x=Inf, y=-Inf,
           label="Exports ↑ / Additions ↓",
           hjust=1.1, vjust=-0.6, size=4, fontface="bold") +

  # Country points and labels
  geom_point(aes(color=Study_scope), size=3.5) +
  geom_text_repel(
    aes(label=Area, color=Study_scope),
    size=3.5, box.padding=0.6, point.padding=0.3,
    force=5, max.overlaps=Inf, max.time=4,
    seed=42, show.legend=FALSE
  ) +

  # Symmetric pseudo-log axes
  scale_x_continuous(
    transform=scales::pseudo_log_trans(sigma=0.001),
    limits=c(-x_lim, x_lim),
    expand=c(0, 0)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    transform=scales::pseudo_log_trans(sigma=0.001),
    limits=c(-y_lim, y_lim),
    expand=c(0, 0)
  ) +

  # Region colors
  scale_color_manual(values=c(
    "North America"="#E76F51",
    "South America"="#2A9D8F"
  )) +

  labs(
    title="Changes in Solar PV Trade and Deployment in 2024",
    subtitle="Year-over-year changes from 2023 to 2024",
    x="Change in Chinese Solar PV Exports (GW)",
    y="Change in Annual PV Capacity Additions (GW)",
    color="Region",
    caption="Symmetric pseudo-log axes (sigma = 0.001)."
  ) +

  theme_minimal(base_size=12) +
  theme(
    plot.title=element_text(face="bold", size=16),
    legend.position="bottom",
    panel.grid.minor=element_blank(),
    aspect.ratio=1
  )
```

```{r quadrant-summary}
library(gt)

quadrant_summary <- change_2024 %>%
  count(Study_scope, Quadrant, name = "Countries") %>%
  mutate(
    Study_scope = factor(
      Study_scope,
      levels = c("North America", "South America")
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(Study_scope)

quadrant_summary %>%
  gt(groupname_col = "Study_scope") %>%
  tab_header(
    title = "2024 Trade–Deployment Change Patterns",
    subtitle = "Changes from 2023 to 2024"
  ) %>%
  cols_label(
    Quadrant = "Change Pattern",
    Countries = "Number of Countries"
  ) %>%
  cols_align(
    align = "center",
    columns = Countries
  ) %>%
  opt_row_striping() %>%
  tab_options(
    table.font.size = px(14),
    data_row.padding = px(8),
    row_group.font.weight = "bold"
  )
